before.action: I turn my childhood photograph toward the decision.

before.speaker: B
before.text: You aren't that child anymore.

before.speaker: A
before.text: No, but that child has very strong opinions about the signature.

after.speaker: A
after.text: My teenage self would hate me buying this sensible car.

after.speaker: B

after.text: Exactly the sort of sentence he swore never to say.

after.speaker: B
after.text: Then buy the motorbike.

after.text: Some ambitions were symbolic. Loyalty wasn't.
